'''Lokar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He directed [[Sith Warrior]]s to Lord [[Krimyn]] for advanced training.<ref name="Advanced" />

==Behind the scenes==
Before its removal from the game, Lord Lokar introduced the mission "Advanced Training: Sith Warrior" for Sith Warrior players who had just completed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He could be found both on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and in the [[Sith Sanctum]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where he directed players to their Advanced Class trainer, Lord [[Krimyn]].<ref name="Advanced" />
